opportunities.title: Menswear styling test & social content shoot
opportunities.description: Male models for an independent menswear brand styling test and social content shoot in Leyton (E10). £75 per 2–3 hour session, paid by bank transfer on the day. Requires height 6ft+ and waist 30in or smaller; brief mentions fluid/androgynous garments and some skin exposure. The listing says to DM your details. Deadline shown as 2 November 2026 — check availability immediately and confirm the exact wardrobe/coverage before agreeing.
opportunities.application_method: DM your details via the casting listing

opportunities.title: Male model — menswear brand lookbook shoot
opportunities.description: Male model for Fifth Digit's menswear lookbook in Chesterfield, Derbyshire (listed under Sheffield). Age 21–29; ideally 6ft+ and size M/L, slim or athletic. Travel costs covered; rate to be agreed, portfolio images included. Your 188cm height is above the listed preferred range of 179–185cm, so treat as a possible long-shot and ask before applying.
opportunities.application_method: Apply through the individual ModelManagement casting page

opportunities.title: Male and female / family models — lifestyle property shoot
opportunities.description: One-day lifestyle shoot in city-centre Leeds for a show-home development, with a dog on set. Up to £300 depending on experience. The male age preference is 25–37, so this is outside your stated casting age range (22); retained for transparency but not a recommended match.
opportunities.application_method: Apply through the individual ModelManagement casting page (age preference 25–37)

opportunities.title: Male and female fit models needed
opportunities.description: Manchester-based fit-model agency recruiting male and female models; £38.50–£40/hour, no experience needed. Male sizes XS–XXXL; applicants submit collar, chest, natural waist, seat and shoe measurements. Listed height preference is 167–185cm, so your 188cm is above the stated range; check with the agency before applying.
opportunities.application_method: Apply through the individual ModelManagement casting page and submit measurements

opportunities.title: Relaxed London street photography — portfolio collaboration
opportunities.description: Photographer seeking a model for relaxed street-style portraits around East London. All experience levels welcome; unpaid collaboration with edited photos for portfolio/social use. Daytime shoot, date and location arranged together. Message the photographer through the casting listing.
opportunities.application_method: Message the photographer through the casting listing

opportunities.title: Male models — social media campaign shoot
opportunities.description: Male models aged 18–30 for a social media campaign shoot on 4–5 November 2026. The public job board lists the fee as TBC (so pay is marked Unknown, not unpaid). Reference KPMZ-7378. The board says applicants need to be Models Direct models; check membership/agency terms, shoot location and usage before proceeding.
opportunities.application_method: Apply via Models Direct (existing members sign in; new applicants may need to join the agency)

opportunities.title: Fashion campaign — cast aged 20–50
opportunities.description: Open casting for a luxury fashion brand campaign in London on 8 November 2026. Cast aged 20–50; £3,000 inclusive of one year of all-media usage including print. Talent Talks states a 15% commission for subscribed members or 20% for non-subscribed members. The page says new applicants must create a profile and then apply. Confirm role/gender breakdown, availability, terms and net payment before applying.
opportunities.application_method: Create a Talent Talks profile if needed, then apply on the individual audition page

opportunities.title: Wellness supplement campaign — models and real people
opportunities.description: Casting for men and women aged 18+ for a UK wellness brand launch campaign. Experienced models and real people welcome. Rate listed as £500 per shooting day; location is UK, to be confirmed; shoot dates are expected in mid-November. The casting page stated it was closing in 6 days when checked on 1 November 2026. Open the original board and verify that it is still accepting applications, the exact deadline, usage terms and travel arrangements before applying.
opportunities.application_method: Open Casting London's listing and confirm the campaign is still accepting applications
